contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

evidenceContentId.description: sha-256 content address (64 lowercase hex). Normative derivation: the frozen AISE-CONTENT-V1 canonical encoding (see apps/android ContentIdentity).

subjectId.description: Opaque stable identifier assigned by the authority that owns the object.

subjectKind.description: Open vocabulary (lower_snake_case) naming the subject's entity kind, seeded from spec/domain-model.md entity families (e.g. `property_assertion`, `measurement`, `reality_object`, `boq_item`).
